scripts.clean-branch: node -e "process.platform === 'win32' ? require('child_process').exec('powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/clean-branch.ps1') : require('child_process').exec('bash scripts/clean-branch.sh')"
scripts.clean-branch:force: node -e "process.platform === 'win32' ? require('child_process').exec('powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/clean-branch.ps1 -Force') : require('child_process').exec('bash scripts/clean-branch.sh --force')"
